regions.name: Indus
regions.quote: Widely-distributed from the Indus basin in Pakistan, through Bangladesh, Myanmar, and much of India including the Ganges-Brahmaputra, Barak, Mahanadi, Krishna, and Cauvery drainages as well as a number of smaller river basins.
